verdict.rationale: Cal.com publishes a v2 API reference with per-endpoint pages, schema fragments and a sample request header, but nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser. A static reference is adjacent to this story, not the capability itself. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so no machine-readable spec backing an interactive explorer was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
